title: How much are we charging?
description: Enter the amount and the register issues a Pix QR Code valid for {{minutes}} minutes.
amountHint: Type digits only — the decimals fall into place.

steps.title: How it works
steps.one: The register stores the charge in Flask and asks the simulated bank for a payload.
steps.two: The screen shows the Pix QR Code with an expiration countdown.
steps.three: Once the bank confirms, the charge is marked as paid.

errors.min: The amount must be greater than zero.
errors.createFailed: We could not issue this charge. Please try again.
